name_en: Tare katsudon — thin pork cutlets dipped in sweet soy sauce over rice
summary_ja: 薄めのとんかつを甘辛い醤油だれにくぐらせてごはんにのせる新潟市発祥の丼。卵とじにせず、カツを2枚以上のせるのが特徴で、昭和初期に古町の洋食店から広まったと伝わる。
summary_en: A Niigata City-born rice bowl of thin pork cutlets dipped in a sweet-savory soy sauce and laid over rice, no egg involved, typically with two or more cutlets. It is said to have spread from a Western-style restaurant in the Furumachi district in the early Showa era.
source_title: タレかつ丼 新潟県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
